defects.summary: The shared D13 unconfined caveat is reworded for every runtime, so codex's rows lose the true 'a shell is always there' sentence; this is outside the stories, but deviation 60 records it, and the seed's legend (runtime-capabilities.json:11) and the RuntimeCapabilities.Unconfined doc comment still use the old wording.
E5.6 decision 2 says each Kimi row's note carries the version 2.1.1, but the notes do not; the version is only in measuredWith.version.

The 'refused before the launch' arm is a non-git root that QuestionRowLaunch refuses in PlaceAsync before any junction is made, so in that arm the recorder and person-hash checks prove nothing junction-first, and the row's coai-question-* scratch is not checked (deviation 60 admits the scratch gap).

S5.6.5's none arm asserts the launch's ScratchDir, not the row's real empty folder that QuestionRowLaunch makes, and the test would also pass before this change because E5.4's KimiConsultant already follows the plan (deviation 53 records this).

The status line and deviation 59 contain '[redacted]' placeholders and say the gate's model command was not followed with no recorded approval, so the plan's own record of these stories is incomplete.
